ask: can u make a sign up sheet for the tasks and time slots
sentence: A shared sign-up sheet where people pick tasks grouped by time slot, each task has a limited number of spots, and everyone can see who has signed up and drop out again.
use_when: Sorting out who does which job at a move-in or move-out day
Filling tasks across several time slots with a set number of helpers per task
Checking which tasks still have no one signed up
Planning any group event with shifts, errands, or things to bring
dont_use_when: Choosing one option for the whole group, like a vote or poll
Finding a single meeting time that works for everyone
Splitting costs or tracking who owes money
